description: Aménagements cyclables Naolib de Nantes Métropole is a dataset listed in Open Data Nantes Métropole, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Nantes Métropole. Aménagements cyclables sur le territoire de Nantes Métropole La publication du schéma de données sur les aménagements cyclables apporte une modélisation dont l'objectif est de produire une information harmonisée sur le territoire nationale. Coverage: Nantes Métropole. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are vélo, cycle, voirie, aménagement cyclable, Naolib, Patrimoine. The portal shows 9,981 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte-LO (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-nantesmetropole-fr-portal.
